notes.note: Heading of the DHCP reservations section on the page of a reserved host.
Introduction of the DHCP reservations section on the host page.

segment.source: The reservation of an address follows the identity of its interface. DHCPv4: the client identifier when the interface has one, else the MAC address. DHCPv6: the DUID when the interface has one, else the MAC address.

notes.note: Shown when the reserved host has no address on a live interface.

segment.source: This host has no active or planned address on an interface, so there is nothing to reserve.

notes.note: Column header: what the reservation is keyed by.
Column header: whether the DHCP server serves the reservation.
Column header: the lease on the address.
Before the client identifier a reservation is keyed by.
Before the MAC address a reservation is keyed by.
The interface has neither a MAC address nor a client identifier (IPAM-18).

segment.source: No MAC address or client identifier: no reservation

segment.source: No DHCP scope serves this network
